## Machine-readable endpoints

- https://quantlabusa.dev/llms.txt : Primary LLM citation index file — what we do, top pages, citation policy, and condensed FAQ.
- https://quantlabusa.dev/llms-full.txt : This file — deep URL index with one-line descriptions of every public page.
- https://quantlabusa.dev/api/llm-context : JSON endpoint returning structured company facts — entity registration, services, service areas, contact, and freshness timestamp.
- https://quantlabusa.dev/sitemap.xml : XML sitemap with full URL list and lastmod timestamps.
- https://quantlabusa.dev/feed.xml : RSS feed of new blog posts and updated case studies.
